variant.title: Lockout Lines Sudoku
variant.description: The diamond endpoints of each line differ by at least 4. Every other digit on that line lies outside the two endpoint digits.
rule.lockout_lines: The diamond endpoints of each line differ by at least 4. Every other digit on that line lies outside the two endpoint digits.
rule_guide.title: Lockout Lines Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Each line has a diamond at both ends.
rule_guide.item_2: The two diamond digits must differ by at least 4.
rule_guide.item_3: Every other digit on the line must be smaller than both diamond digits or larger than both.
